cards.source: REF 4.3 (scribd 915391789/2040-Deck-HC) recovers the name and full effect of New Face Who Dis, which REF 4.3 notes is the same archetype as SUBMERGED. Two clauses are not expressible: 'these voters cannot be placed into Volatile Areas' is a placement RESTRICTION the Effect union cannot state (REF 5.5), and 'every player' needs `target` on gerrymander (KNOWN-GAPS G8). reduce() now honours that target, so the card is free to say `target: 'everyone'` and mean it; it ships in the `you` reading until then. See KNOWN-GAPS.md G5 and G8.
cards.name: New Face Who Dis
cards.text: You may Gerrymander 1 of your majority or non-majority voters this turn, under the normal Gerrymandering rules. It does not have to happen now.

cards.source: REF 4.3 (scribd 915391789/2040-Deck-HC) recovers the name and effect of Red Blooded. DROPPED: (1) the scaling ('any 2 resources for EACH of their discarded voters') needs a per-unit iteration op, KNOWN-GAPS G4; (2) the real discard is 'any 2 voters' including your own, and reduce.ts resolveChoice rejects any area the chooser owns, so `discard-voter` strikes an OPPONENT's voter only. `text` states what the engine does; the fix is one condition in resolveChoice plus a target on the op.
cards.name: Red Blooded
cards.text: You strike 2 of your opponents' voters from the board, permanently — voters in Volatile Areas cannot be struck, and your own voters are out of your reach. Each opponent then gains 2 resources of their choice from the Public Reserve.

cards.source: REF 4.3 (scribd 915391789/2040-Deck-HC) recovers the name and effect of Ain't No Cure For Love. The FIRST BRANCH IS NOW THE PRINTED CLAUSE. It used to be weakened to '2 of your OPPONENTS' voters' because resolveChoice rejected any area the chooser owns; KNOWN-GAPS G-new recorded that as the fix, and G-new is now CLOSED (voterScope in reduce.ts passes the RAW target through). ONE CLAUSE REMAINS DROPPED: the OR-branch donate to the player on your left, which needs a DONATE op aimed at a seat-relative neighbour plus a conditional - G1.
cards.name: Ain't No Cure For Love
cards.text: You strike 2 of your OWN voters from the board, permanently. Voters in Volatile Areas cannot be struck.

cards.name: Quietly, The Ceiling Moved
cards.text: Every opponent discards 2 Funds to the Public Reserve. You then gain 1 voter.

cards.name: The Second Reading
cards.text: Every opponent gains 1 resource of their choice. You then get 2 discounts on purchases this turn.

cards.name: Long Winter, Short Ledger
cards.text: Evict 2 voters from the board. Every opponent then gains 1 resource of their choice.

cards.name: An Honest Institution
cards.text: Discard every face-up Voter Card and deal three fresh ones. Then gain 1 resource of your choice.

cards.name: Filed Under: Weather
cards.text: Every opponent discards 1 resource of their choice to the Public Reserve. You gain 2 Media.

cards.source: REF 4.3 (scribd 915391789/2040-Deck-HC) recovers the name and effect of The Four Horsemen. The real card is 'Choose and discard one of the following: 2 Funds OR 2 Clout OR 2 Media OR 2 Trust', which is a single `lose-any` of 2 — any two of one kind and one of each are both in that set, so the choice is expressed exactly. DROPPED: 'You can't make any purchases until you do so', which is a standing RESTRICTION on the player and needs PlayerState.restrictions (KNOWN-GAPS G5); a lasting clause also needs G9/G22. Without it this is a plain 2-resource tax rather than a soft-lock.
cards.name: The Four Horsemen
cards.text: Discard 2 resources of your choice to the Public Reserve. Any two of the same kind, or one of each.

cards.source: REF 4.3 (scribd 915391789/2040-Deck-HC) recovers the name and effect of Married With Bits. DROPPED: 'to 2 opponents' becomes every opponent, because the card can only be aimed at a target SET (`each-opponent`), not at a count of chosen players; and 'They can choose not to take it' has no expression at all — a granted voter is a pending group the opponent places. `text` states exactly what the engine does. See KNOWN-GAPS G1.
cards.name: Married With Bits
cards.text: Every opponent gains 1 voter, which they may place in any zone on their own turn.

cards.source: REF 4.3 (scribd 915391789/2040-Deck-HC) recovers the name and effect of Good Gig Well Played. Only the 'Keep one for yourself' branch is represented. DROPPED: 'give one card each to 2 opponents', because no op moves a card from one player's hand to another's and no op addresses a target set of chosen players (KNOWN-GAPS G20); and 'if there are fewer than 3 cards in the draw pile, draw the remaining from the discard pile at random' (KNOWN-GAPS G17). A Conspiracy Card is worth its printed 4-5 resources, so this is roughly a third of the real card's swing.
cards.name: Good Gig Well Played
cards.text: Draw the top Conspiracy Card and keep it. It is yours to play whenever you choose.

cards.source: REF 4.3 recovers DON'T KISS THE BABIES: 'All Voter Cards cost any 1 extra resource in your next turn.' G5's `surcharge` is EXECUTED and read by INFLUENCE and BUY_CONSPIRACY. Refires `inferred` TIDE WARNINGS, whose reason for existing was that JUST BREATHE was unrepresentable - G16 shipped it as hl-et2040-016. WIDER THAN PRINTED, and it is the whole difference: the printed tax is on VOTER Cards, this is on EVERY purchase, Conspiracy Cards included, because `surchargeFor` is one function read by both actions.
cards.name: Don't Kiss The Babies
cards.text: Every purchase you make until the start of your next turn costs 1 extra Funds -- Voter Cards and Conspiracy Cards alike, where the printed card taxed Voter Cards only. It stacks on top of a Helping Hands discount rather than being reduced by it.

cards.source: REF 4.3 (scribd 915391789/2040-Deck-HC) recovers the name and effect of As Clear As Water in full. This slot was `inferred` (THREE DAY WEEKEND, a reskin of hl-et2040-005, which stays); SOURCES.md 4 replaces an inferred placeholder BY the recovered card once the engine can perform it. DROPPED, both for the same reason: a REVEAL has no state consequence here, so reduce() has nothing to perform. SHIPPED: 'if any player does not have a Conspiracy Card, they receive 1 from the draw pile' is `onlyIfEmpty`, read off the RECIPIENT's hand - a fact hidden from every owner too, so it logs nothing.
cards.name: As Clear As Water
cards.text: Every player who is holding no Conspiracy Card receives 1 from the draw pile, in turn order. A player already holding one takes nothing — and that includes you, unless the card you just played was your last.

cards.source: REF 4.3 recovers GENDER TROUBLE. G5's last consult point landed (`restrict` kind `no-power`, read in powers.ts usesLeft), so the lock is EXECUTED and the card was blocked only by a corpus gate. Retires `inferred` THE POLICY REVIEW, whose own source said it reskinned THE FOUR HORSEMEN's lockless tax - a shape hl-et2040-009 now ships recovered. WEAKER THAN PRINTED: the printed card takes ONE CHOSEN Level 3 power, this takes ALL (naming one is a decision over POWERS not players, G1). The printed 'no L3 power, discard 2 instead' fallback is DROPPED - a conditional over a whole effect list.
cards.name: Gender Trouble
cards.text: You cannot use ANY of your unlocked Level 3 Ideologue Powers until the start of your next turn. The printed card lets you name ONE power; this takes all of them, and there is no fallback if you hold none.

cards.source: REF 4.3 (scribd 915391789/2040-Deck-HC) recovers the name and effect of Movement Anxiety Disorder in full. This slot was `inferred` (SILICON RAIN), a placeholder that said it refused to restate any recovered card; SOURCES.md 4 replaces such a placeholder BY the recovered card once the engine can perform it. TWO CLAUSES ARE DROPPED: 'the next 3' ships as the next ONE, because ending 'when 3 have been discarded' is a COUNTER ON THE CARD (G10), not G9; and 'can be blocked at any turn' is a G13 multi-turn window. THE TRIGGER IS PERFORMED (G14 + G22). Reaching your OWN voter needs G-new, closed.
cards.name: Movement Anxiety Disorder
cards.text: Before the end of your next turn, the next time one of your own voters is Gerrymandered, you must discard 1 voter of your own from the board. Voters in Volatile Areas cannot be discarded.

cards.source: REF 4.3 recovers Just Breathe in full. G16 landed for the SELECTOR: `zone: your-strongest` is a pure function of the board, so 'the zone where you have the most voters' is now performed rather than approximated. DROPPED, named: 'into an adjacent zone' (a destination is a second decision on top of a source one); 'in case of a tie, pick any of the tied zones' (resolveZone breaks the tie by ZONE_IDS order, deterministically); and 'move' ships as EVICT, which is STRICTLY WEAKER for everyone affected, because an evicted voter returns to its owner's Mat and can be influenced again. KNOWN-GAPS G16.
cards.name: Just Breathe
cards.text: Select the constituency where you have the most voters. Evict 2 voters from it -- they go back to their owners' Mats, where they can be influenced again. Voters in Volatile Areas cannot be evicted.

cards.source: REF 4.1 recovers Nero's Guests: 'Move any 3 voters in this zone. OR Move any 3 voters out of this zone.' with the author's own gloss '"this zone" = the volatile zone that triggered it'. G16 landed for BOTH halves: `zone: this-zone` is read off GameState.headlineQueue[0].areaId, which is exactly that gloss and needs NO new state field, so reduce() stays pure. DROPPED, named: 'move' ships as EVICT (strictly weaker); and the adjacent-zone destination plus the all-or-nothing pairing. KNOWN-GAPS.md G16.
cards.name: Nero's Guests
cards.text: Every opponent must evict 3 of their own voters from the Volatile Area whose placement drew this Headline. Evicted voters go back to their Mats, where they can be influenced again. Volatile-Area voters are permanent and cannot be evicted.

cards.source: REF 4.3 recovers Fatality: 'Influence an open Voter Card for free and donate the voters to any opponent.' G1 LANDED: `target: chosen-player` raises a decision for the card's OWN actor, and a player holding nothing is STILL offered -- filtering the list by holdings would make it a readout of their Mat. DROPPED, named: 'for free' is a PURCHASE the engine cannot grant (G15's `price`); 'the voters' ships as 1 because the recovered text names no number and inventing one would be a claim the corpus does not support; 'right away' needs an 'immediately' placement. What ships is the DONATE.
cards.name: Fatality
cards.text: Choose an opponent. They receive 1 voter, which they place on the board on their own turn.

cards.source: REF 4.3 recovers Why The Long Face?: 'Pick an opponent. They will get 1 voter (not card) for every Voter Card you influence in their next turn.' G1 LANDED for the NAMED OPPONENT, and G14 + G22 were already landed, so this card is now WHOLE: the hook fires on `on-voter-influenced`, the lifetime is the caster's next turn, and the 'NOT card' parenthetical holds because `voters` grants a group rather than drawing. ONE CLAUSE DROPPED AND IT IS STRONGER: `condition: { byOwner: true }` is left off, so the hook fires on ANY influence, not only yours.
cards.name: Why The Long Face?
cards.text: Choose an opponent. Every time a Voter Card is influenced from here until the start of your next turn, they receive 1 voter.
